data.title: Court upholds Feb 8 election, rejects objection to coded ballots
data.description: The Constitutional Court on Monday ruled that ballots with barcodes and QR codes were designed for effective election supervision and did not violate voters' rights and liberties protected by the Constitution.

data.title: Charter Court dismisses petition challenging February election's legality
data.description: The ​Constitutional Court ​on ‌Monday ruled that ​ballot ⁠papers used ‌in February's general election ⁠did not violate voter secrecy, ​effectively dismissing a ​petition ‌challenging the legality ​of ⁠the ⁠vote.

data.title: Campari, Alchemy Wines & Spirits celebrate Negroni Week 2026
data.description: Bangkok, Thailand – Campari and Alchemy Wines & Spirits (Thailand) recently hosted Thailand’s official Negroni Week Opening Night at Stella, Capella Bangkok, marking the 14th edition of the global initiative that brings together the international hospitality community in support of meaningful social and environmental causes.

data.title: Bangkok floods 2026: In brief
data.description: You asked, we are here to answer. With many of our news desk reporters and editors either working remotely due to floodwaters or wading through inundated streets to reach the newsroom, we are working non-stop to deliver real-time updates as the situation develops.

data.title: Comedian on trial for insulting Erdogan in standup show
data.description: ISTANBUL — A popular Turkish comedian goes on trial at an Istanbul court on Monday facing charges of insulting President Recep Tayyip Erdogan and other offences during a stand-up performance in June.

data.title: Singha R-SA deploys 4WD vehicles, aids teams to flood-hit areas
data.description: Although flooding in Bangkok has begun to ease, several communities remain in urgent need of assistance, with some residents still stranded in affected areas or temporarily sheltering at evacuation centres.

data.title: NT Achieves Google Gold Verified Peering Provider Status
data.description: National Telecom Public Company Limited (NT) has achieved Google Gold Verified Peering Provider (VPP) status, reaffirming its commitment to delivering highly reliable connectivity for enterprise customers accessing Google's digital ecosystem.

data.title: Government allocates 2 billion baht for flood relief
data.description: The government has allocated 2 billion baht for nationwide flood relief as part of its mid-year budget plan for fiscal 2026 to assist disaster victims, according to Paradorn Prissananantakul, Minister Attached to the Prime Minister’s Office.

data.title: Thai shuttler Kunlavut into men’s singles final at Asian Games
data.description: Thailand’s world No.2 Kunlavut Vitidsarn has reached the men’s singles final at the 20th Asian Games, the first Thai male badminton player to reach the event’s title match.

data.title: Pinehurst Launches “PINEHURST MEET & GOLF 2026”
data.description: Beyond golf — A place of happiness, a place for everyone

data.title: Frasers Property Thailand launches “Thread to Thrive” campaign
data.description: “Thread to Thrive” (Terb To Dai, Terb To Dee) interactive experience transforms a passageway into a space for ideas and invites the public to envision and co-create a city that supports their aspirations for growth

data.title: Tolls mount in Thailand, Myanmar floods
data.description: Heavy rains have killed eight people in Thailand since mid-September, the government said on Monday as Bangkok battled flooding for a fourth consecutive day, with at least eight more confirmed dead in neighbouring Myanmar.

data.title: Deer rescue at Siam Amazing Park after 6 drown
data.description: Ten drowning hog deer were rescued from the flood at Siam Amazing Park in Bangkok's Kannayao district, but six others were found dead in the water.

data.title: Nothing to seal here: NZ police help stranded pup home
data.description: WELLINGTON — New Zealand police came to the rescue of a seal crossing a busy road, helping the perplexed pinniped pup back safely into the water, they said Monday.

data.title: Water levels still rising in many flooded provinces
data.description: Floodwater levels continue to rise in almost half of the 27 inundated provinces, the Disaster Prevention and Mitigation Department said on Monday, as a new warning was issued for people living downstream from the Mae Klong River Dam in Kanchanaburi.

data.title: Jet ski 'drifter' surfing Bangkok flood arrested, fined
data.description: A man who rode a jet ski through Bangkok floodwaters, deliberately making waves along submerged Phetchaburi Road on Sunday evening, was later arrested and charged with causing a public nuisance.

data.title: The 1 Central Group partners with Central Department Store to officially sponsor Bangkok Albion FC
data.description: The 1 Central Group, Thailand’s No.1 digital lifestyle and loyalty platform and one of Asia’s Top 5 Center of Life platforms, under Central Group, has joined forces with Central Department Store, a lifestyle retail destination under Central Retail, to officially support Bangkok Albion Football Club (Bangkok Albion FC).

data.title: Track sensation Puripol eyes more records after 2nd sprint gold
data.description: Thailand's track sensation Puripol Boonson says he can still go faster after completing the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games men's sprint double with another meet record.

data.title: India, Pakistan on Asian Games collision course after cricket washout
data.description: NAGOYA — India and Pakistan stayed on course to meet in the Asian Games cricket final after both men's quarter-finals were abandoned Monday because of rain and a sodden outfield in Nagoya.

data.title: Soldiers help clear baggage backlog at airport amid flooding
data.description: Soldiers were deployed to speed up the handling of gridlocked luggage at Suvarnabhumi Airport on Monday after city-wide flooding prevented many ground staff reporting for work, causing hours-long flight delays over the weekend.
